name: Qwen3.6 35B A3B
description: Primary Fast certification target for routine chat and short agent loops.

performance.note: The target-only profile passed the Fast gate with exact 32K recall, complete capability probes, bounded resident memory, and a zero-swap 60-minute endurance run. The artifact also includes an experimental native BF16 MTP shard; its measured GB10 profile is opt-in and slower than target-only decode.

limitations: The fixed five-problem AIME sample scored 0/5 because all five sampled runs exhausted the 2,048-token reasoning budget before emitting a final answer; Fast certification establishes serving correctness and operational behavior, not benchmark-quality certification.
Certification covers text inference at batch one on one NVIDIA GB10.

Native MTP is experimental: width three reproduced the controlled target-only output hash but measured 8.57 tok/s versus 52.63 tok/s without speculation; widths one and two did not reproduce that hash.
